layers: vehicleInlet — what is on the car
stationOutlet — what is on the wallbox (tethered coupler or socket)
gridPlug — how the EVSE is connected to the building (hardwired, or a high-current socket)

vehicle.name: Type 2 (Mennekes)
vehicle.maxStandard: 43 kW AC (400 V 3φ 63 A) — rare at home
vehicle.signalling: CP (control pilot PWM) + PP (proximity / cable current coding)
vehicle.gender: Female vehicle connector, male vehicle inlet; female station socket, male cable plug
vehicle.homeStation: Tethered Type 2 cable, or untethered Type 2 socket-outlet (preferred in EU public and many homes)
vehicle.notes: EU mandated AC interface. Three-phase is why 11 kW / 22 kW home charging exists in Europe.

vehicle.name: Type 1 / SAE J1772
vehicle.standard: IEC 62196-2 Type 1 = SAE J1772 AC coupler
vehicle.signalling: CP + PP (proximity switch, no PP resistor current coding like Type 2)
vehicle.gender: Female vehicle connector, male vehicle inlet. No station socket-outlet in common NA practice — almost always tethered.
vehicle.homeStation: Tethered J1772 cable on a Level 2 wallbox, or portable EVSE with J1772 coupler
vehicle.notes: Single-phase only. North American homes use 240 V split-phase, so 11.5 kW (48 A) is the practical home ceiling for most cars.

vehicle.name: NACS / SAE J3400
vehicle.standard: SAE J3400 (Tesla-originated North American Charging Standard)
vehicle.maxStandard: AC up to 80 A at 277 V (~22 kW) in the standard; residential 48 A @ 240 V typical
vehicle.signalling: CP + PP; same AC pin functions as J1772, so passive NACS↔J1772 AC adapters exist
vehicle.gender: Compact five-pin; the two large contacts carry AC or DC
vehicle.homeStation: Tethered NACS wallbox, or J1772 wallbox + OEM adapter. Tesla Mobile Connector / Wall Connector.
vehicle.notes: Home AC charging looks electrically like J1772 Level 2. The same inlet is used for DC Supercharging — DC is out of AC scope.

vehicle.name: GB/T AC
vehicle.maxStandard: Mode 3 up to 27.7 kW (440 V, 63 A) in the standard; home almost always 7 kW 1φ
vehicle.signalling: CP + CC (charging confirmation) — not the same PP coding as IEC Type 2
vehicle.gender: Physically similar to Type 2 but reversed: male vehicle connector, female vehicle inlet. Do not mate with IEC Type 2.
vehicle.homeStation: GB/T AC socket or tethered GB/T AC coupler on a 7 kW wall pile
vehicle.notes: Separate AC and DC inlets on the car (not CCS combo).

vehicle.name: Type 3 (Scame) — deprecated
vehicle.maxStandard: Historically used in Italy/France EVSE sockets
vehicle.homeStation: Do not specify for new home installations
vehicle.notes: Superseded by Type 2 in the EU.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: Hardwired wallbox
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Dedicated circuit, RCD, no plug. Required or preferred by many codes above a given current.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: NEMA 5-15 (Type B)
gridAndHomeSupply.regions: USA, Canada, Mexico, Japan (similar Type A/B)

gridAndHomeSupply.name: NEMA 14-50
gridAndHomeSupply.rating: 50 A 125/250 V (40 A continuous → 9.6 kW @ 240 V)
gridAndHomeSupply.regions: USA, Canada — range / RV outlet, dominant plug-in home EVSE
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Four-wire: L1, L2, N, PE. Neutral is unused by most EVSE but present on the plug.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: NEMA 6-50
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Common alternative to 14-50 where no N is needed.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: Schuko CEE 7/3–7/4 (Type F) / CEE 7/7
gridAndHomeSupply.rating: 16 A 250 V; continuous EV use typically 8–10 A
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Mode 2 only. Not a home charging station. Thermal limit of the plug is the constraint.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: Type E (CEE 7/5)
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Mode 2. Earth pin in the socket.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: BS 1363 (Type G)
gridAndHomeSupply.rating: 13 A fused plug; EV Mode 2 typically ≤ 10 A
gridAndHomeSupply.regions: UK, IE, MY, SG, AE, SA, HK
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Mode 2 travel cable. Daily charging should be a Mode 3 wallbox.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: AS/NZS 3112 (Type I)
gridAndHomeSupply.rating: 10 A common, 15 A / 20 A also used
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Mode 2; dedicated 15 A sockets sometimes used. Wallbox preferred.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: GB 1002 / GB 2099 (Type I / A)
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Mode 2. Home charging stations are GB/T AC wall piles.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: IEC 60309 blue 16 A 1φ (6h)
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Robust Mode 2 or plug-in wallbox supply. Preferred over Schuko for regular use.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: IEC 60309 blue 32 A 1φ
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Single-phase industrial socket used as a home EV supply.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: IEC 60309 red 16 A 3φ 400 V (6h, 3P+N+E)
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Common three-phase industrial socket; also used to feed 11 kW wallboxes or Mode 2 3φ cables.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: IEC 60309 red 32 A 3φ 400 V
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Upper bound of home AC in this overview.

gridAndHomeSupply.name: IEC 60309 blue 3φ 230 V (Norway IT)
gridAndHomeSupply.notes: Clock position / colour differs from red 400 V. Not interchangeable with TN 400 V CEE.
